meta.name: Light of My Lion
meta.description: The appearance of a mysterious little boy interrupts the quiet, predictable life shared by an artist with autism and his caring older brother.

videos.title: Meeting Lion
videos.overview: Hiroto Komori lives a calm life with his younger brother Michito, who has autism. One day, a little boy calling himself Lion shows up at their house.

videos.title: Are you involved in a murder?!
videos.overview: After Hiroto gets a message on Lion's phone directing him to a specific place, he tells Michito to look after Lion and sets out to find the location.

videos.title: We GO to the Zoo! Also, Who are his parents?
videos.overview: Hiroto believes he may have found out who Lion's father is. Later, he takes Michito and Lion to go see Michito’s art on display at the zoo.

videos.title: Birthdays are happy days
videos.overview: After Lion suddenly comes down with a fever, a worried Hiroto takes him to the hospital but realizes he doesn't even know how old the boy is.

videos.title: I'm Going to See My Mother~
videos.overview: Kudo writes an article claiming that Aoi is still alive. A mysterious man tells Aoi her cover has been blown and helps her evade the police.

videos.title: The decision of My Sister and the truth
videos.overview: Hiroto reads a news article about Aoi and wonders why she would tell such a blatant lie. Later, he learns the stunning truth about her and Lion.

videos.title: The trip to protect Lion
videos.overview: In hopes of keeping Lion’s whereabouts a secret, Hiroto takes him to an island with Michito. Meanwhile, Shougo visits the Komori brothers’ house.

videos.title: The Sister's commitment...and a time to say goodbye
videos.overview: With Yurugi's help, Aoi heads to Sado to reunite with her family. Later, she explains her actions, and Hiroto expresses his pent-up frustrations.

videos.title: I want to save Lion!
videos.overview: Hiroto and Michito hurry to the Tachibana house to rescue Aoi and Lion but find no one there. Meanwhile, Aoi and Shougo come to an agreement.

videos.title: The biggest storm and Falling out of love
videos.overview: Inspired by Michito's decision to participate in an overnight trial at a new artists' group home, Hiroto takes action to rescue Aoi and Lion.
